title: Does Mirsal make stickers or custom emoji
question: Does Mirsal make stickers or custom emoji?
answer: Mirsal makes Telegram stickers, including animated stickers. The emoji attached to a sticker is its tag, not a custom emoji output.

title: Should I use the AI chat or Studio
question: Should I use the AI chat or Studio?
answer: Use the AI chat to describe what you want in everyday words and refine it in conversation. Use Studio when you want explicit controls for the prompt and sticker settings.

title: What is the difference between a batch and a sheet
question: What is the difference between a batch and a sheet?
answer: A batch is one generation of stickers. Its sheet contains the individual pictures arranged in cells; each sticker keeps its original cell number through review and animation.

title: What limits apply to an animated Telegram sticker
question: What limits apply to an animated Telegram sticker?
answer: Animated stickers use transparent WEBM video and must fit within 256 KB. Mirsal targets 512 by 512 pixels, at most three seconds and 30 frames per second, with no audio.

title: What limits apply to a static Telegram sticker
question: What limits apply to a static Telegram sticker?
answer: Static stickers use PNG or WEBP with transparency and must fit within 512 KB. Mirsal makes the final sticker on a 512 by 512 pixel canvas.
sources: mirsal/mirsal/console/packs.js: owner send control, sticker details
